text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The first race of the Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho, is today, and Yukino Bijin has been invited to an interview beforehand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's quite common for popular Umamusume to give interviews, but…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: What did you have for dinner last night, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Pork cutlet on rice, 'cause it's lucky!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: How nice! I know you're still young and very busy, but is there anyone out there you'd especially like to see you race?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I can only choose one? Gee, I don't know if I can! Obviously, I want my mom t'watch, but I also want my dad, my little sister, and all my friends to—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: That's very lovely, but… I'm wondering more if maybe you've got a special someone out there…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A special someone? Like…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: OHHH! N-n-n-no, I don't!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reporters only ask Yukino Bijin about her private life. This interview is a far cry from your average racing interview.
choice_data_list: Does anyone have a question related to racing?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: How about a word for your fans watching at home? In that cute accent of yours, if you don't mind!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh? Uhhh…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run my tail off t'get the win! So, I'll be count'n on your s'pport!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: H-how was that? Could you hear my accent?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Yep! I swear, you're the cutest little bumpkin ever!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the reporters laugh.

text_block_list.name: Racing Newspaper Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I don't know if I've ever seen reporters from those stations at one of these racing interviews…

text_block_list.name: Racing Newspaper Reporter B
text_block_list.text: They're here because of Yukino Bijin. Everyone's trying to write a piece on her recently. Heck, I'm only here because my boss demanded photos.

text_block_list.name: Racing Newspaper Reporter B
text_block_list.text: I guess she's a proper celebrity if she's that in demand…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Plenty of Umamusume before Yukino Bijin have reached this same level of fame, but the reason she's so popular is a bit different.

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: All right, that's all the time Yukino Bijin has for today!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sigh… That was nerve-rack'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: How'd I do?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank goodness. Now I can—

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text: Our next Umamusume is ready for your questions!

text_block_list.name: Racing Newspaper Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Finally! I've been waiting for this all day.

text_block_list.name: Racing Newspaper Reporter D
text_block_list.text: I've got to get this article out ASAP!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The mood suddenly changes as the TV crews make way for the regular racing reporters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shiiiing!

text_block_list.name: Racing Newspaper Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming today, Harp Alpha.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Harp Alpha is a racer many are expecting great things from on the Triple Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's quite likely she'll be Yukino Bijin's biggest rival at the Oka Sho. We've been keeping our eyes on her, but…
choice_data_list: (It looks like we're not the only ones.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Can we stay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm feeling kinda restless… I think it'd be a good idea for me t'listen in.

text_block_list.name: Racing Newspaper Reporter B
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling about the upcoming Oka Sho, Harp Alpha?

text_block_list.name: Racing Newspaper Reporter C
text_block_list.text: I heard you expressed concerns for your legs after your first race. How are you feeling now?

text_block_list.name: Racing Newspaper Reporter D
text_block_list.text: You ran quite aggressively at your last race. Are you sure you're ready to run again so soon?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The questions rain down one after the other. It's a complete one-eighty from Yukino Bijin's interview.

text_block_list.name: Harp Alpha
text_block_list.text: I'll run the way I'm going to run. That's all I can say.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Holy smokes…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Talk about a cool cat…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's like she isn't phased at all. As cool and confident as a cucumber on a motorcycle.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Eek! It's noth'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Makes sense, though, right? The Triple Tiara's gonna be full of great runners like her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Which means I gotta give this race my all! Don't worry, I'm ready!
